values.note: Village rates (page undated, read 2026-10-22): non-waterfront lots 21-36 $33 a day ($445 a month); waterfront lots 1-10 and canal lots 11-20 and 37-39 $38 a day ($475-485 a month), all electric/water/sewer 30/50-amp; rustic canal lots 41-44 $25. Cash or check only; payments non-refundable. Boat trailer storage $50 a month.

values.note: Lots 1-39 with full hookups (waterfront 1-10, canal 11-20 and 37-39, non-waterfront 21-36) and rustic canal lots 41-44 with no water or electricity (no generators). Lots 1-20 are seasonal waterfront lots with a waiting list. One dock per site, up to 25 ft.

sites.source: https://villageofotterlake.com/campground/ (lot ranges above; 'Lots 1 thru 20 are seasonal waterfront lots with a waiting list') + rules PDF ('One (1) dock per site must not exceed 25' in length'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reservations open April 15 by phone (810-793-4258); 50% deposit within 5 days, balance 5 days before arrival; holiday stays paid in full. Memorial Day and Labor Day weekends 3 nights, the July 4th holiday 6 nights. Rustic canal lots 14 nights at most. A no-show by 9pm loses the lot unless paid in full.

[14-night maximum stay]', 'Call (810) 793-4258'), read 2026-10-22

note: Municipal campground operated by the Village of Otter Lake on Otter Lake at 5902 Genesee St, with waterfront, canal and back lots, rustic canal lots (no generators), a beach and boat launch. Distinct from the nearby private 'Genesee Otter Lake Campground.' --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the village's page: open Apr 15 - Oct 15, full hookups 30/50-amp, phone 810-793-4258, phone reservations with a 50% deposit. Changed nightly_low 38 -> 33 (non-waterfront lots; waterfront/canal $38) and sites 44 -> 43 (lots 1-39 and 41-44); added holiday minimums (3 nights, July 4th 6), lot notes. Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated: laundry or dump (derived values left), max rig length, FCFS (derived some_sites left).
flags: Largely seasonal: 'Lots 1 thru 20 are seasonal waterfront lots with a waiting list', so the 20 waterfront/canal lots the entry's lakefront rating rests on are seasonal; nightly stays are in practice the non-waterfront lots 21-39 and the rustic canal lots (about 23 of 43). Every lot class also has a monthly rate. Rates are undated on the page (page footer (c) 2020).
